for which she was receiving oral contraceptive pills and analgesics.                                 Comment [OET4]: received: use the past

On 21/09/2005, Ms. Bowen presented at my clinic with deep, inflamed nodules and cystic acne
spread on her face and different body parts. Accordingly, she was prescribed systemic and local
antibiotics. However, her acne condition had continued to worsen over the following two              Comment [OET5]: usually, past perfect is
months, therefore, she was referred to a dermatologist.                                              used when you have two or more events in
                                                                                                                             st
                                                                                                     the past we write the 1 in past perfect and
                                                                                                     the following events in past simple. in this
Today, Ms. Bowen reported that she had stopped taking the oral contraceptive pills; however,         context
she was finding difficulty in getting pregnant. Additionally, she complained of amenorrhea,          Comment [OET6]: found: using the past
depression and weight gain. On examination, her BMI was 28 and hirsutism was observed. Her           continuous here is inappropriate
labarotory investigations revealed low levels of vitamin D and FSH hormone. However, there was       Comment [OET7]: laboratory
an increased in oral glucose tolerance test and free androgen index. Besides that, a significantly
elevated prolactin level was detected. Thus, she was prescribed Climen 10 mg four times daily,
and a pelvic ultrasound was ordered.

Kindly find an attached copy of her test results for your valuable review.

Should you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely
Doctor
